title: Incident communication
subtitle: Draft the status post and customer email from an incident record. Nothing is published until a person approves the exact text.
loadError: We could not load incident data.
noIncidents: No open incidents and none in the last 30 days.
selectIncident: Select an incident to draft communication for it.

settings.requireSecond: Require a second person to approve SEV1, SEV2 and major incidents
settings.requireSecondHelp: On by default. If you are the only staff member, turn this off temporarily and note why in the incident channel.

new.heading: New draft
new.customerActionHelp: Plain words, no links or contact details. Leave empty if there is nothing to do.
new.emailNotAllowed: Only SEV1 and SEV2 may email subscribers.

draft.heading: Drafts
draft.empty: No drafts for this incident yet.
draft.stale: The promised next-update time has passed. Generate a new draft before sending.
draft.saved: Edits saved. Any earlier approval was reset.
draft.reviewed: I have read the status post and the email exactly as shown above.
draft.sendConfirm: This publishes the status post and emails subscribers. It cannot be undone.
draft.secondPerson: A second person must approve this one. You drafted or submitted it.
draft.awaiting: Waiting for a second person to review.
draft.partial: Sending stopped part-way. Steps that already completed will not be repeated on retry.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.conflict: That action is not allowed in the current state.
errors.lint_blocked: The text did not pass the safety checks. See the list below.
errors.draft_stale: The promised next-update time has passed. Generate a new draft.
